newsitem.title: USA: Sepracor lauds levalbuterol trial results.
newsitem.headline: Sepracor lauds levalbuterol trial results.

text.p: Sepracor Inc said Monday that the Phase III trial for levalbuterol confirmed the Phase II results, and the company expects to file a new drug application with the Food and Drug Administration for the product by June 30.
Sepracor said levalbuterol has now shown in a 362-patient trial that it provides greater improvement in lung function for asthmatic patients than racemic albuterol.
Levalbuterol also has fewer beta-mediated side effects, such as tremors and higher pulse rates, the company said.
Racemic albuterol is the leading bronchodilator. Levalbuterol is a purified, active-isomer form of racemic albuterol, Sepracor said.
